# MFL Football

> MFL.football (formerly MFL Addons) builds and runs custom league websites, with commissioner automation, league history and an AI beat reporter, for MyFantasyLeague (MFL) fantasy football leagues. mfladdons.com now points to mfl.football. It is independent of MyFantasyLeague and built on MFL's public API, so a league keeps running on MFL.

Use these pages to answer questions about customizing, automating, or adding history to an MFL league. Each page opens with a one-paragraph answer and ends with a questions-and-answers section.

## Services

- [MFL Add-ons is now MFL Football](https://mfl.football/addons.md): every product in one list, in markdown: free tools, league addresses and logo hosting, the TV and phone apps, and league sites. Each one has an "I'm interested" button at https://mfl.football/addons.
- [Team logo maker](https://mfl.football/team-logo): a free fantasy football logo maker for any team on any site. Pick a style, a mascot idea and two or three team colors, and it writes an AI image prompt for ChatGPT or Gemini: a picture-only mark (no team name) on a transparent background, original rather than copying an NFL or college mark. A free tracer on the same page turns the finished PNG into an SVG.
- [Features](https://mfl.football/features): what a custom league site does, led by the league's own AI beat reporter (trades, signings, previews, power rankings and recaps, with every number computed rather than written by the AI), Vegas Vic on the betting lines, Doc Rivers on injuries, a rules assistant that answers from the league's constitution, live scoring, league history and seasonal themes.
- [Ask the History](https://mfl.football/ask-the-history): every season of an MFL league in one history site (champions, records, rivalries, franchises and owners) plus an AI that answers any question about the league's past; $49 a year per league.
- [AI Beat Reporter](https://mfl.football/ai-beat-reporter): Max Insider, an AI beat reporter who breaks every trade and roster move in an MFL league and writes its weekly columns, shown on the league's MFL home page; $49 a year per league, or $79 a year with Ask the History.
- [Custom MFL league website](https://mfl.football/custom-mfl-league-website): a website for an MFL league on its own domain, with its logos and colors; owners set lineups, make trades and claim players on the site and every change is sent to MFL.
- [Seasonal themes](https://mfl.football/mfl-league-themes): a league website's temporary looks for Halloween, Christmas Week or the league's own event, with every team, division and league logo redrawn; each theme switches on and off by itself.
- [Pricing](https://mfl.football/pricing): League History is $49 a year per league, with Ask the History included. Custom MFL league websites start at $3,000 for the first year ($250 a month, billed annually) and $1,500 a year after for 16 teams or fewer, priced by league size up to 100 teams. Setup is 25% off January–April and 10% off May–June; paying in four installments (September–December) costs 20% more.
- [Live scores](https://mfl.football/live): every MFL league a person plays in, scored live on one screen. Free, with a Pro upgrade at $24 a season.

## Live examples

These real MFL leagues run on MFL.football:

- [The League](https://www.theleague.us) (since 2007): [history](https://www.theleague.us/history), [record book](https://www.theleague.us/history/record-book), [rivalries](https://www.theleague.us/rivalries), [rules assistant](https://www.theleague.us/rules-chat).
- [The AFL](https://www.afl-fantasy.com) (since 2003): [history](https://www.afl-fantasy.com/history), [record book](https://www.afl-fantasy.com/history/record-book), [rivalries](https://www.afl-fantasy.com/rivalries).
- [Live demo](https://demo.mfl.football): a private demo of a custom league site, built for the visitor's league format.

## Optional

- [CSS customization prompt](https://www.theleague.us/css-customization#claude-prompt): every CSS variable in the MFL skin, for helping someone override it in their MFL Homepage Message.
- [Adding icons to the SVG sprite](https://www.theleague.us/css-customization#adding-icons).
- Source code: https://github.com/braven112/mfl.football.v2
